speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing chronic bladder discomfort and frequent urination; to help me determine the cause, how long have these symptoms been occurring, and do you notice any pain when you urinate?

speaker: Patient
text: 40-year-old female. The patient reports a 5-month history of worsening bladder discomfort, which is relieved by voiding. speaker: Doctor
text:
